build_commands.label: prepare_output_dir
build_commands.description: Create output directory for image and receipt.

build_commands.label: verify_src_tree
build_commands.cmd: test -d /usr/src && freebsd-version -k || echo WARN: no src tree
build_commands.description: Check FreeBSD source tree is present at /usr/src.

build_commands.label: place_kernel_config
build_commands.cmd: cp SMOLBSD.conf /usr/src/sys/amd64/conf/SMOLBSD 2>/dev/null || echo 'INFO: using existing SMOLBSD config'

build_commands.label: place_release_conf
build_commands.description: Deploy release config (package filter + rc.conf fragment) into FreeBSD source tree.

build_commands.label: buildworld
build_commands.stub_reason: STUB: buildworld takes 2–8 hours on typical hardware. Run manually on a FreeBSD build host.
build_commands.description: Cross-compile FreeBSD world for target arch.

build_commands.label: buildkernel
build_commands.stub_reason: STUB: buildkernel takes 30–90 minutes on typical hardware. Run manually on a FreeBSD build host.

build_commands.label: pkgbase_packages
build_commands.stub_reason: STUB: pkgbase package build takes 30–60 minutes.

build_commands.label: build_vm_image
build_commands.cmd: make -C /usr/src/release vm-image KERNCONF=SMOLBSD TARGET=amd64 TARGET_ARCH=amd64 WITH_PKGBASE=yes VMFORMATS=qcow2 VMSIZE=4096m CLOUDWARE_CONF=/usr/src/release/tools/smolbsd-qemu.conf
build_commands.stub_reason: STUB: vm-image build requires completed buildworld/buildkernel. Output goes to /usr/obj/amd64.amd64/usr/src/release/vm/

build_commands.label: fetch_agent
build_commands.stub_reason: STUB: agent fetch from (agent-url-stubbed) — verify sha256 after fetch.

build_commands.label: install_agent_into_image
build_commands.cmd: # Mount image, copy agent binary to /usr/local/bin/none, install rc.d script, unmount
build_commands.stub_reason: STUB: requires mounted image. In real build, vm_extra_pre_umount() hook handles this.

build_commands.label: copy_image_to_output
build_commands.stub_reason: STUB: depends on completed vm-image step.

build_commands.label: emit_receipt
build_commands.description: Emit attestation receipt JSON alongside the image.
